::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
```{=html}
<div class="post-toolbar no-print" role="group" aria-label="Post actions">
  <button type="button" class="post-toolbar__btn" data-action="share" title="Share">
    <i class="bi bi-share" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Share</span>
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="post-toolbar__btn" data-action="print" onclick="window.print()" title="Print">
    <i class="bi bi-printer" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Print</span>
  </button>
  <a class="post-toolbar__btn" data-action="pdf" href="index.pdf" download title="Download as PDF">
    <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Download</span>
  </a>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var bar = document.querySelector('.post-toolbar');
  if (!bar) return;
  var shareBtn = bar.querySelector('[data-action="share"]');
  if (shareBtn) shareBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var data = { title: document.title, url: location.href };
    if (navigator.share) { navigator.share(data).catch(function () {}); return; }
    if (navigator.clipboard) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(location.href).then(function () {
        var s = shareBtn.querySelector('span'), prev = s.textContent;
        s.textContent = 'Copied'; setTimeout(function () { s.textContent = prev; }, 1500);
      }).catch(function () {});
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```
